The astronomer {npc:Spectulus}, of Edron, wants to build a magical device capable of sailing the 'sea of light'. You recover the plans from a beggar who used to be a scientist, pick up a rare crystal in the Lost Mines and use that crystal to enter the lair of {creature:The Collector}, in Vega, from where you bring back the Mirror Crystal. You earn experience, a {item:Yellow Gem} and 10 {item:Small Diamond|Small Diamonds}.
Spectulus, top of the central tower of the Noodles Academy (Edron)
to break the rare crystal in the Lost Mines
2 gp to give to the {npc:Shoddy Beggar}
After you complete the quest, with {npc:Spectulus}.
Bring a {item:Pick}: without it you cannot take the {item:Rare Crystal} in the Lost Mines.
After handing in the plans you have to wait **30 real minutes** before mission 2. Use the time to head to the Lost Mines straight away.

Take a boat to **Edron** (for example, with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s harbour. The {wiki:Noodles Academy of Modern Magic} is the seven ivory towers in the **east** part of the city; the **central** tower is the tallest (nine floors). To leave, go down the same stairs.
Towers of the Noodles Academy (Ivory Towers)

In **Edron**, go up to the top floor of the central tower of the Noodles Academy of Modern Magic and talk to {npc:Spectulus}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He wants to find the inventor of a device that sails the *sea of light* and tells you that a beggar in Edron knows more.
Look for the {npc:Shoddy Beggar} in Edron. Say {key:hi} and {key:spare}, and reply as in the table (you pay 1 gp twice). At the end he gives you the {item:Plans for a Strange Device}.
Go back to {npc:Spectulus} and say {key:mission} twice. He keeps the plans and asks for time to study them. Wait **30 real minutes**.

After the 30 minutes, say {key:mission} to {npc:Spectulus} and reply {key:yes} three times. He needs a rare crystal from the Lost Mines so that you can reach the Collector's lair, which guards the last Mirror Crystal.

Leave **Edron** to the **west**, to the peninsula of trolls and goblins ({wiki:Edron Troll Cave} to the north, {wiki:Edron Goblin Cave} further south). The **Lost Mines** are between the two caves, near the sea. Bring the {item:Pick}.
Inside there are {creature:Rat|Rats}, {creature:Undead Mine Worker|Undead Mine Workers} and {creature:Undead Prospector|Undead Prospectors}.
At the **end of the mine**, use the {item:Pick} on the big cyan-blue crystal to get the {item:Rare Crystal}.
Go back the same way to the mine entrance and return to **Edron**, to the **east**, to the central tower of the Noodles Academy.

Say {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes} to {npc:Spectulus}. He gives you back the {item:Rare Crystal} and hands you the {item:Carrying Device}, and explains that the Collector's pit is on an island near Carlin.

At the harbour in Edron, say {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. In **Carlin**, head **north-west** to {npc:Nielson}'s raft (one of the {wiki:Nordic Tibia Ferries}) and say {key:hi}, {key:vega}, {key:yes} (20 gp from the mainland to an island). You disembark in the **east** of {wiki:Vega}, next to {npc:Carlson}'s raft.
In Vega there are {creature:Frost Troll|Frost Trolls} and {creature:Polar Bear|Polar Bears}.
Carlson (east of Vega, arrival and return)
Use the crystal on the Ice Cube
In Vega, follow the coast **south-west** until you find a {item:Stony Pond}. Use the {item:Rare Crystal} on the {item:Ice Cube}: you are teleported to a cave.
Go to the end of the cave and kill {creature:The Collector}. Then use the {item:Carrying Device} on his corpse to get the {item:Filled Carrying Device}.
Leaving the cave and going back to Edron

To leave, go back the same way to where you arrived in the cave and return to the surface of Vega. Go to the **east** of the island and talk to {npc:Carlson}: the trip from an island to the mainland is **free** ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}). In Carlin take the boat back to **Edron** ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain).
Go back to {npc:Spectulus}, say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. The crystal slips from his hands and breaks... but the quest is complete and he lets you keep the remains.
Experience, Yellow Gem and 10 Small Diamonds (quest rewards)
